  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Finite date-rule compilation}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

Rules are small composable predicates. Compilation requires inclusive domain
endpoints and returns selected civil dates.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(jwcalendarR)
```

```{r}
rule <- rule_and(on_weekday(1:5), rule_not(on_month_day(1)))
cal <- compile_calendar(rule, "2027-01-01", "2027-01-31")
calendar_count(cal)
calendar_next(cal, "2027-01-01")
calendar_contains(cal, c("2027-01-04", "2027-01-09"))
```

The compiler enumerates the finite domain, so cost grows with the number of
days requested. It is intended for clear bounded validation tasks; the first
release is not a high-performance recurrence engine or general SAT solver.
